notes.title: Momento 🧸 now has Satisfying Snapping
notes.content:
Hope you are well! We are doing great 🤗 Jasmine is heading off to Cologne in a week or so! We are also still working on the game hehe ✨

For those going to Gamescom this is where we will be: Hall 10.1 Booth A.080! We will be showcasing Creative Mode at this festival! We can’t wait to see the different rooms you’ll make~ 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44776801/69f6dfca979fb33b425116f16d023759806047b7.png[/img]

So what have we been doing? I love looking back on our previous updates when I write these because it is insane to me how much gets done within a month.

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
[tr]
[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44776801/21a7e80a33471339ce7238a12b741a31f108e47e.jpg[/img][/td]
[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44776801/0b836eb093ec0728004cba41cde850e9b2d12ba1.gif[/img][/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
[i]Jasmine and I testing out Julian’s systems of stacking, snapping, and containers~ 🥰[/i]

Julian:
[list]
[*] Snapping and Zone Tests for objects for easier placement
[*] Putting objects inside of other objects (stacking objects) (yes, you can now repot plants into other pots technically) - it’s not perfect yet but we’re definitely going to be working on it further after the Gamescom build!
[*] Refactoring container and creative mode managers
[/list]
[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
[tr]
[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44776801/b78d79488b0031bd8e6df5d39ad0fdccda58c55f.jpg[/img][/td]
[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44776801/d419492f7e7640fc722bb71654a5937568ff223c.jpg[/img][/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
[i]We’ve been told that Tim Tams are all the rage at Gamescom![/i]

Jasmine:
[list]
[*] Finalized art assets for the additional rooms and interval puzzles
[*] Masks for colliders
[*] Reviewing art of old rooms to include open and closed states
[*] Getting stuff ready for Cologne (Tim Tams, more stickers, business cards and the like!)
[*] Story teaser art
[*] Making TikToks
[*] Item States for some objects (I finally know how useful convert to smart object is 🤔)
[/list]
[table noborder=1]
[tr]
[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44776801/cd61544661a9d06654fd3502ce0cc754d0fc60a1.jpg[/img][/td]
[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44776801/b1375a235eecfa73e29cc74e87c9114e71ead2f7.jpg[/img][/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
[i]Teenage Bedroom Objects plus some concept sunset lighting - and lava lamp shader in progress![/i]

Jess:
[list]
[*] Story treatment review
[*] Additional object art for rooms (remember CD players?? Remember burning CDs to play in your car? Wild)
[*] Additional Light rays for additional windows
[*] Making custom shaders for all our lighting setups (including a lava lamp shader)
[*] Story item descriptions review 
[*] Background art cleanup
[*] Gobos for lighting (I have rustling leaf shadows working on it 🥵 yay)
[/list]
We also have an additional programmer, Zac, who is helping out with our databases and systems and will be helping create additional tools for development. 🤩 Jasmine’s partner, Ryan, has been making updates to the website which you can see [url=https://playmomento.com/]here[/url]! We also have our audio team SubZero and our composer, Mikey O’Neil, doing a lot of cool stuff in the music and SFX department! 🎶 I’m using too many exclamation points!!

Stay tuned for more updates! ✨ We’re going to aim to be more present on socials in the coming months~ ✨ With our creative mode almost finished, we’re going to have a lot more content to share 🥰 We hope you have a great month coming up! 

All of the love 💕
Jess and the Momento Team

notes.title: Momento 🧸 is heading to Gamescom!
notes.content:
Hope you are doing well! 😊In the last month we have: shown off our creative mode at the [url=https://www.queenslandgamesfestival.com/]Queensland Games Festival[/url], applied for some showcases, and Jasmine got a grant to jet off to Gamescom in Cologne next month! Let me show you what's been going on!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44776801/1f0fa8f36591e2bf9b794e696345f070c0af0f41.jpg[/img]
[i]Our latest creative mode build! 🌜Night Time Version🌛[/i]

Our creative mode build is what Jasmine and I will be using to build all the different rooms and connect them with the story-lines that have been laid out! It’ll also be available as a mode you can play in Momento where more items and furniture will unlock as you play through the story (plus maybe there’ll be some hidden ways to get more stuff? 👀)

This is some of the features it has so far:

[list]
[*] Place furniture: Comfort (seating, beds); Surfaces (desks, shelves, bookcases etc.); Wall Items (corkboards, mirrors); Floor Items (rugs etc.), Appliances, Storage.
[*] Place windows! We have backgrounds (currently one (1) but there’ll be more) drawn so when you move the windows around you can find the view you want! There’ll be season changes 🤭 we love making more work for ourselves.
[*] Place objects from a wide ranging list from cushions to plants to laboratory equipment!
[*] This build has five wallpapers and floors to choose from but there’s going to be way, way more.
[*] Can also choose the colour of the wall trim!
[*] Change the time of day from Morning, Midday, and Night time. (Night-time is my favourite. Especially when you add all the glow in the dark stars everywhere 😍 More.)
[*] Take a photo and save your beautiful (or cursed) creations~
[/list]

Here’s what we are working on this month.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44776801/8946abc14cd019c3754d7ee3710dfb89a0f83a20.gif[/img]

Julian: 
[list]
[*] Adjusting the placement system! No more things just hovering in midair :’) though you’ll be able to toggle that on and off in the options if you REALLY want to have things hover in midair. 
[*] Object layering system adjustments.
[*] Julian is also working on a light layering system because at the moment lights that are behind other objects are still rendering in front of those objects.
[*] Branching system rework.
[*] Journal system.
[*] Bin system
[*] Clutter object system.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44776801/b91030cefdd0183fef59bc4d62700b3631cc9482.png[/img]
[i]Colour passes for bug catcher and foster cat interval puzzles.[/i]

Jasmine:
[list]
[*] Art for the rooms and interval puzzles for our vertical slice build to show at upcoming festivals!
[*] Art for the journal UI (including a character creator of a sort? 👀)
[*] Asset layering adjustments.
[*] Reviewing existing assets to ensure furniture with cupboards have an open state.
[*] Mask textures for lighting setups on objects.
[*] Getting ready for gamescom!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44776801/608ef9e118ee9331746ba3a86552452bbda6ed4a.png[/img]

Jess:
[list]
[*] Vertical slice twine update - making sure it makes sense to play through.
[*] Spreadsheets, so many spreadsheets. Spreadsheets for object descriptions, spreadsheets for task list tasks, spreadsheets for journal entries, spreadsheets of consequences.
[*] Reworking story treatment document.
[*] Shaders and headaches for lighting set-ups (currently working on those window gobos I mentioned.)
[*] Shaders for key objects and locations.
[*] Mask textures for lighting set-ups.
[*] Story object art.
[*] This news post 🥰
[/list]

Anyhow, we’d best get back to work! We have a lot to get done over the next month and a half! This month’s question is: What kind of room would you like to make in the Creative Mode? I hope you have a fabulous July ahead! For those in the Northern Hempisphere, enjoy your summer months! It is freezing down here! 🥶

All the love,
Jess and the Momento Team 💕

notes.title: Momento wishes you a Happy Pride Month 🌈
notes.content:
How are you? 🌈 Happy Pride Month! 🌈 I can’t believe it’s already midway through the year, time is just FLYING🪁 We have a lot of things happening for us - all good things - but it really makes the days and weeks just blur together! 😱

Here’s what we’ve been up to this month!

Julian:
[list]
[*] Continued development on Creative Mode
[*] Designing and testing the best way to present the UI for object selection
[*] Drawers and cupboards close and open now!
[*] Improved automatic placement system for objects and furniture
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44776801/ddb8acba2e16c8542cd7d941d79a56b8719e5851.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44776801/e3d19d122e80512c48ea1bf2c454cad528ff46d3.png[/img]
(A room I made in our Creative Mode! Look at that Ivy 😍)

Jasmine:
[list]
[*] Conceptualizing UI for Creative Mode
[*] Finished up a few more rooms 👀
[*] QA on existing art assets for consistency
[*] Designed some stickers to give away during in-person festivals!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44776801/848a4d3c7c8cc89b1e7ace52872dbaa2f2675ef0.jpg[/img]

Jess:
[list]
[*] Creating Twine demos to plan out our story paths
[*] Experimenting with potential relationship branches depending on what objects are kept or thrown away 👀
[*] Developing supporting characters further
[*] Conceptualizing lighting direction for different time of days
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44776801/ecf605e88b356bc95e3a25bf985d327561816ef6.png[/img]
(This is a [b]concept[/b] of how these characters might be shown in the game - as sketches that change as the player character grows older. 👀👀)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44776801/ed33eb6048925ac8078d09710221927cf8cc19cd.png[/img]
(Here’s an example of our sunset lighting setup! Honestly I really love all of them so it’s so hard to choose which one to show. 🌄☀️)

Hope the rest of your week goes really well and that our newest update gives you some excitement! ✨

All the love, 🥰👋
Jess and the Momento Team

notes.title: Momento celebrates International Women's Day!
notes.content:
[b]Current Goal:[/b] Showcase Momento at GDC and keep polishing our current build

Hey everyone! How are you all doing? March is going to be very busy for us, but first things first:

Happy Birthday, Momento! 🎉🎉🎉

It’s been almost a year since we first came up with the idea of Momento and we’ve come so far in a year. Thank you for your continued support and interest in our cozy little game! (Also it’s Issy’s birthday in less than a week too! Happy birthday, Issy - I don’t know how you’re already one year old but it feels like it’s been an entire lifetime!)

Momento will also be part of the [url=https://twitter.com/womenledgames/status/1762489792304959668]Women Led Games Showcase[/url] on March 8-10! Celebrate International Women’s Day with us by watching the live show on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/womenledgames]Twitch[/url] or [url=https://www.youtube.com/@women-ledgames]Youtube[/url] on March 8th 5PM EST!

I (Jess) was selected to be part of the Future Leaders’ Delegation organised by the games section of the Australian Government - so I will be headed over to San Francisco to showcase Momento at some events during the Game Developers’ Conference. Jasmine and Julian will be manning the fort!

[b]Back to the game’s progress! What’s been going on?[/b]
[list]
[*] Testing how best to structure our naming conventions so we don’t have to redo it a million times
[*] Freshening up our pitch deck for GDC
[*] Lining up meetings, and meetings, and [i]more meetings…[/i]
[*] Polishing the latest prototype build
[*] Fleshing out the narrative branches and story item descriptions
[*] Exploring gameplay mechanics for choosing key objects
[/list]
[b]What the team has been up to:[/b]

Jasmine
[list]
[*] More Interval Puzzle art
[*] Polishing main rooms
[*] Conceptualizing GUI elements
[*] Streamlining the asset export process
[*] Building Momento’s visual art guide for future-proofing
[/list]
Julian
[list]
[*] Importing all the new assets into the current build
[*] Building a dynamic tutorial sequence
[*] Implementing a basic level transition system
[*] Building tools from scratch to streamline importing assets into Unity
[*] Polishing and bug fixing on the GDC build
[/list]
Jess
[list]
[*] Pre-GDC preparations
[*] Mentorship and networking as part of the Future Leader’s Delegation
[*] Creating more story items and objects
[*] Writing item descriptions
[*] Conceptualizing gameplay mechanics that better supports the story
[/list]
Thank you so much for your support and interest in Momento! We can’t wait to show you more soon!

Cheers,
Jess and the Momento Team 💖
